en.description:
Balloon puts you in the basket. Turn the Digital Crown one way to run the burner and climb, the other way to vent and descend -- no tap-to-flap, no tilting your wrist, just the Crown against a constant gentle downward drift. Fly through rings to score, and decide, mid-air, how much of that score you're willing to risk to keep going.

WHY IT WORKS ON A WATCH

Most arcade ports fight the small screen and borrow a phone's control scheme. Balloon is built around the Crown instead: rotation direction maps directly to vertical thrust, so flying never puts a finger over the action and the whole game plays one-handed, arm raised, no iPhone required.

RISK AND REWARD, NOT JUST SURVIVAL

Every ring you pass adds to an at-risk pool worth more than the last -- the longer you go without cashing in, the more there is to lose. Tap the screen to bank it into your permanent score. Miss a ring or clip the terrain and the whole at-risk pool is gone, on top of costing a life. Clear all 50 rings in a course with lives to spare and you get a choice: cash out, or push into a harder course carrying your score and lives forward.

FEATURES

- Crown-direction flight control: burner to climb, vent to descend, a genuine analog feel rather than discrete taps
- 6 biomes with distinct terrain, sky, and hazards -- Classic, Desert Canyon, Nightfall, Snowy Peaks, Coastal Waters, and Sunrise (thermal updraft currents), each with its own wind behavior and difficulty
- 5 selectable balloon skins (Ember, Meadow, Twilight, Aurora, Solar), each with its own envelope gradient and gore-panel stripe accent
- Risk/reward banking: escalating per-ring value, wiped by a miss or a crash, banked permanently with a tap -- same push-your-luck tension as a favorite pick-up-and-play card game
- Precision, moving, Flame Shield bubble, and Gold Magnet rings alongside standard rings, with floating streak milestone toasts and particle burst feedback
- In-game Career Stats tracking (total flights, courses cleared, precision rate %, max streak, lifetime score) accessible directly from the menu
- Crown haptic feedback toggle, in-flight pause controls, real-time stat tracking, and sound FX mute toggle
- Per-biome Game Center leaderboards and local per-biome high score badges plus achievements for banking big, surviving on continues, and clearing courses
- A watch face complication showing your high score at a glance
- Persisted high score across launches, and a 3-lives, always-a-choice course structure that never just ends on you mid-run

No ads, no analytics, no in-app purchases, no account required. Balloon runs entirely on your Apple Watch -- open it from your wrist and fly.
en.releaseNotes:
Balloon 1.1 brings a massive upgrade packed with a new Sunrise biome, Flame Shield and Gold Magnet rings, Career Stats, vector atmospheric depth graphics, procedural wind and high-BTU burner audio, new balloon skins, and altimeter HUD gauges!

WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 1.1:

• NEW SUNRISE BIOME: A sixth biome joins the rotation, with thermal updraft currents that push the balloon around as the sun comes up. Classic, Desert Canyon, Nightfall, Snowy Peaks, Coastal Waters, and Sunrise each fly differently.
• FLAME SHIELD & GOLD MAGNET RINGS: Two new ring types alongside standard, precision, and moving rings. Flame Shield grants a protective bubble that absorbs a hit, Gold Magnet pulls nearby rings toward your flight path.
• CAREER STATS: Track total flights, courses cleared, precision rate, max streak, and lifetime score from the menu, so progress carries across every session.
• CROWN HAPTICS: Optional haptic feedback on the Digital Crown makes burner and vent input tangible without looking at the screen. Toggle it on or off in the menu.
• VECTOR ATMOSPHERIC DEPTH: Overhauled visual engine featuring 3-layer parallax terrain strata, volumetric cloud layers, desert mesa bands, snow-capped mountain ridges, coastal wave reflections, and glowing nightfall aurora waves.
• PROCEDURAL WIND & HIGH-BTU BURNER AUDIO: Real-time procedural wind noise (synthesized in engine via AVAudioSourceNode) dynamically morphs cutoff frequencies, whistling howl, and gust turbulence as your flight speed, altitude, and biome weather change. Paired with a high-BTU propane burner roar driven by an exponential volume decay envelope for smooth pressure release tails on Crown release.
• NEW BALLOON SKINS: Unlocked 2 new balloon skins -- Aurora (vibrant cyan/magenta night glow) and Solar (radiant gold/orange zenith) -- joining Ember, Meadow, and Twilight for 5 total customizable envelopes with gore-panel accents.
• ALTIMETER & HUD GAUGES: Added an altimeter gauge for precision height tracking, a smooth Digital Crown thrust meter, glassmorphic HUD overlays, and terrain rim highlights.
• STREAK MILESTONE TOASTS: Chain consecutive ring passes to trigger floating streak milestone toasts and high-roller score celebration bursts.
• IN-FLIGHT PAUSE SHEET & MUTE TOGGLE: Access real-time run stats (rings remaining, banked vs. at-risk score, lives) and an instant Sound FX mute toggle directly mid-flight.
• GAMEPLAY POLISH & CRASH CAMERA DAMPENING: Decoupled camera shake and particle physics from pause/game-over state so crash landings dampen naturally, and resolved initial spawn terrain collision bugs.
en.subtitle: Crown-Controlled Ring Flight
